finding: AgentExit is a useful donor for paired stop-efficiency/progress-damage measurement and exit-to-continuation structure, but its concrete same-model verifier, free-form YES substring latch, direct EXIT control and AgentBoard-heavy harness should not become F2 authority or be imported wholesale.

source_mechanism.extrinsic: same llm_model judges history and latches exit_flag on substring YES
source_mechanism.task_loop: EXIT breaks before the next environment action while success remains environment-derived done
source_mechanism.continuation: recorded trajectory can be replayed until early exit and generation resumed

f2_fusion_hypothesis: Translate only the thin pattern into a typed advisory StopCandidate envelope bound to causal event/cycle/generation/state/evidence/resource deltas. Candidate transitions are HOLD/WAIT/ASK/DELEGATE/REOBSERVE/STOP_COGNITION. COMPLETE remains a separate evidence-gated state and is unreachable from this controller.
counterhypothesis: A deterministic repeated-state + no-new-evidence + hard-budget controller may outperform any model verifier after verifier latency, circular self-judgment and premature-stop errors are included.
resource_light_design: Start with deterministic counters/digests already available in F2 rather than a second LLM call.
Use model verifier later only as an advisory feature if deterministic evidence is insufficient.
Do not import AgentBoard, environment forks, provider wrappers or W&B into WP509 runtime.
Measure saved transitions against progress degradation and recovery, not token reduction alone.
next_discriminator: E2 map the StopCandidate envelope onto exact current WP509/WP505/WP600-603 interfaces; then E3 deterministic held-out fixture comparing A deterministic baseline, B progress-aware StopCandidate, C optional bounded adaptive thresholding.
metric_cautions: The paper/README define Redundancy Steps and Progress Degradation conceptually, but this E1 source audit did not locate code that independently reproduces the exact formulas.
Flat task progress is not automatically redundancy: newly admitted negative evidence must count as information gain.
False COMPLETE must remain structurally zero.
security_hygiene_note: A tracked .env path exists in the audited tree; contents were intentionally not read or copied. This is only a hygiene warning, not a secret-leak claim.
